test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words underlined in the sentence.**

Only t__he artists who make sculptures__ are allowed to take part in exhibitions.
solution: The correct answer is: **Sculptor** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word '**sculptor**' means a person who creates sculptures. (एक व्यक्ति जो मूर्तियाँ बनाता है) • **For example- ***The sculptor figured the girl in clay.* • It is the most appropriate word that matches the meaning of the group of words underlined in the sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Painter **refers to a person who creates paintings. (एक व्यक्ति जो पेंटिंग बनाता है) • **Artisan **refers to a skilled worker who creates things by hand. (एक कुशल श्रमिक जो हाथ से चीज़ें बनाता है) • **Potter **refers to a person who creates pottery items such as bowls, plates, etc. (एक व्यक्ति जो मिट्टी के बर्तनों जैसे कटोरे, प्लेट आदि बनाता है) 1d0:T905, The correct answer is: **Cheque**.
